entries._comment: The OPEN-ENDED DESCRIBE-IT ask (row 0c280989), keyed on the ask's own id rather than its wording. It is the sibling of the document_choice card: the card appears when 2..cap candidates match, this appears when the expeditor has to ask which document at all. Six copies across six profiles had drifted into three different wordings, so a change in _handle_fuzzy_file_match would have silently unanswered some and not others. The id is matched exactly, narrowed by the `agents` tag and by arg_name, before the model is asked anything. THE ANSWER IS DELIBERATELY PER-PROFILE and must not be collapsed: these are fixture choices for standalone profiles, not divergence.

entries.question_pattern: What engineering task should the SWE Team work on?
entries.answer: add a health check endpoint to the API

entries.question_pattern: Would you like to set a budget limit
Would you like to set a timeout
Which local document should I read first? Describe it or say the filename.
entries._comment: "none" ON PURPOSE. `source_document` is OPTIONAL (row 14c54c10), so an unattended run has no document to name; answering with a path would make every proxied research run silently read a fixture and report on it. Required by test_deep_research_covers_all_fallback_questions and test_all_agents_profile_covers_all_arg_names, which demand an entry for every fallback question the contract declares.

The DOCUMENT CHOICE CARD, keyed on the card's own id rather than its wording (row a1420538) — the same generic entry every other file-arg profile carries. Added when this chained command declared the file-typed argument `source_document` (row 5726e3c5). NOT REACHABLE ON THIS COMMAND TODAY, and deliberately so rather than by oversight: `source_document` is OPTIONAL, so it never enters extraction.missing and the fuzzy_file_match handler that raises this card never fires for it. The entry is here so the card is ANSWERED the day it becomes reachable — when the file browser lands, or if the argument ever gains a special handler — instead of an automated run hitting an unanswered card and cancelling. test_every_file_arg_has_a_profile_that_answers_it enforces exactly this.
